Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. S.R.S. Gill, Advocate for the applicant.
2. Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, A.G.A. for the State.
3. The applicant, who is in judicial custody in
connection with FIR/Case Crime No. 0046 of
2026, under Sections 8/21/60 of NDPS Act,
registered at P.S.-Kotwali Tankapur, District
Champawat, has sought his release on bail.
4. In this case, applicant was arrested
alongwith the co-accused from the spot and from
his personal search, 110 grams of smack was
recovered.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that applicant has falsely been implicated
in the case; that at present applicant is serving as
Agni Veer and was preparing for other competitive
examination; that there is no independent
witness of the alleged search and recovery; that
amount recovered is below commercial quantity;
that applicant is suffering from severe medical
complications, for which, he has shifted from
District Jail, Pithoragarh to Sub-Jail, Haldwani
and is currently under treatment in Sushil Tiwari
Government Medical Hospital, Haldwani; and,
that the applicant has no previous criminal
history and he is languishing in jail since

29.07.2026.
6. Learned State Counsel, on the other hand,
has vehemently opposed the bail application.
7. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the records.
8. Having considered the submissions, under
the facts and circumstances of the case and also
considering the fact that the alleged contraband
is below commercial quantity, therefore, strict
provisions of Section 37 of NDPS Act would not be
attracted in this case, and, as such, the applicant
has no previous criminal history, this Court is of
the view that it is a case fit for bail and the
applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
9. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant be released on bail on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two
reliable sureties each of the like amount, to the
satisfaction of the court concerned.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 14.10.2026
Ujjwal
